spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, you’re through to Jordan at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi. I’m Rhys Whitlock. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time because your mobile app was down. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry the app being unavailable got in the way of paying your bill, Rhys. I’ll look into this with you. Before we discuss anything on your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And could you confirm the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. Can you tell me when you tried to use the app and what happened with the bill?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was last Thursday, the 15th. I kept getting an error when I tried to make the payment, and the electricity company charged me a late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand why you’re upset. You tried to pay, but the app error stopped you, and you’ve been charged a late fee as a result.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Exactly. I shouldn’t have to deal with that because your app wasn’t working.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I agree it’s frustrating. I’m logging this as a complaint about the app outage and the effect it had on your bill payment. I won’t be able to promise what the outcome will be, but I’ll make sure your concerns are recorded clearly.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send the complaint to our complaints team today, including the date you tried to pay and the late fee you mentioned. I’ll also contact you by phone by 30 October to confirm it’s been passed over and update you on its progress.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaints team will investigate and send you a full written response within 8 weeks. I’ll make sure the team has the details you’ve given me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to summarise: I’m logging your complaint today, I’ll call you by 30 October with a progress update, and you’ll receive a full written response within 8 weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Rhys. I’m sorry again for the trouble this has caused, and I’ll follow this up as agreed.
